verses.he: לְדָוִ֡ד אֵ֘לֶ֤יךָ יְהוָ֨ה ׀ אֶקְרָ֗א צוּרִי֮ אַֽל־תֶּחֱרַ֪שׁ מִ֫מֶּ֥נִּי פֶּן־תֶּֽחֱשֶׁ֥ה מִמֶּ֑נִּי וְ֝נִמְשַׁ֗לְתִּי עִם־יֹ֥ורְדֵי בֹֽור׃
verses.ar: لِدَاوُدَ إِلَيْكَ يَارَبُّ أَصْرُخُ. يَا صَخْرَتِي، لَا تَتَصَامَمْ مِنْ جِهَتِي، لِئَلَّا تَسْكُتَ عَنِّي فَأُشْبِهَ ٱلْهَابِطِينَ فِي ٱلْجُبِّ.
verses.en: A Psalm of David. Unto thee, O LORD, do I call; my Rock, be not Thou deaf unto me; lest, if Thou be silent unto me, I become like them that go down into the pit.
verses.kjv: [A Psalm] of David. Unto thee will I cry, O LORD my rock; be not silent to me: lest, [if] thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.
verses.web: By David. To you, Yahweh, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit.

verses.he: שְׁמַ֤ע קֹ֣ול תַּ֭חֲנוּנַי בְּשַׁוְּעִ֣י אֵלֶ֑יךָ בְּנָשְׂאִ֥י יָ֝דַ֗י אֶל־דְּבִ֥יר קָדְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.ar: ٱسْتَمِعْ صَوْتَ تَضَرُّعِي إِذْ أَسْتَغِيثُ بِكَ وَأَرْفَعُ يَدَيَّ إِلَى مِحْرَابِ قُدْسِكَ.
verses.en: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto Thee, when I lift up my hands toward Thy holy Sanctuary.
verses.kjv: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.
verses.web: Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.

verses.he: אַל־תִּמְשְׁכֵ֣נִי עִם־רְשָׁעִים֮ וְעִם־פֹּ֪עֲלֵ֫י אָ֥וֶן דֹּבְרֵ֣י שָׁ֭לֹום עִם־רֵֽעֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝רָעָ֗ה בִּלְבָבָֽם׃
verses.ar: لَا تَجْذِبْنِي مَعَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ، وَمَعَ فَعَلَةِ ٱلْإِثْمِ ٱلْمُخَاطِبِينَ أَصْحَابَهُمْ بِٱلسَّلَامِ وَٱلشَّرُّ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ.
verses.en: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity; who speak peace with their neighbours, but evil is in their hearts.
verses.kjv: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief [is] in their hearts.
verses.web: Don’t draw me away with the wicked, with the workers of iniquity who speak peace with their neighbors, but mischief is in their hearts.

verses.he: תֶּן־לָהֶ֣ם כְּפָעֳלָם֮ וּכְרֹ֪עַ מַֽעַלְלֵ֫יהֶ֥ם כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְ֭דֵיהֶם תֵּ֣ן לָהֶ֑ם הָשֵׁ֖ב גְּמוּלָ֣ם לָהֶֽם׃
verses.ar: أَعْطِهِمْ حَسَبَ فِعْلِهِمْ وَحَسَبَ شَرِّ أَعْمَالِهِمْ. حَسَبَ صُنْعِ أَيْدِيهِمْ أَعْطِهِمْ. رُدَّ عَلَيْهِمْ مُعَامَلَتَهُمْ.
verses.en: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the evil of their endeavours; give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.
verses.kjv: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.
verses.web: Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings. Give them according to the operation of their hands. Bring back on them what they deserve.

verses.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֤א יָבִ֡ינוּ אֶל־פְּעֻלֹּ֣ת יְ֭הוָה וְאֶל־מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדָ֑יו יֶ֝הֶרְסֵ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יִבְנֵֽם׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُمْ لَمْ يَنْتَبِهُوا إِلَى أَفْعَالِ ٱلرَّبِّ، وَلَا إِلَى أَعْمَالِ يَدَيْهِ، يَهْدِمُهُمْ وَلَا يَبْنِيهِمْ.
verses.en: Because they give no heed to the works of the LORD, nor to the operation of His hands; He will break them down and not build them up.
verses.kjv: Because they regard not the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.
verses.web: Because they don’t respect the works of Yahweh, nor the operation of his hands, he will break them down and not build them up.

verses.ar: مُبَارَكٌ ٱلرَّبُّ، لِأَنَّهُ سَمِعَ صَوْتَ تَضَرُّعِي.
verses.en: Blessed be the LORD, because He hath heard the voice of my supplications.
verses.kjv: Blessed [be] the LORD, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.
verses.web: Blessed be Yahweh, because he has heard the voice of my petitions.

verses.he: יְהוָ֤ה ׀ עֻזִּ֥י וּמָגִנִּי֮ בֹּ֤ו בָטַ֥ח לִבִּ֗י וְֽנֶ֫עֱזָ֥רְתִּי וַיַּעֲלֹ֥ז לִבִּ֑י וּֽמִשִּׁירִ֥י אֲהֹודֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ عِزِّي وَتُرْسِي. عَلَيْهِ ٱتَّكَلَ قَلْبِي، فَٱنْتَصَرْتُ. وَيَبْتَهِجُ قَلْبِي وَبِأُغْنِيَتِي أَحْمَدُهُ.
verses.en: The LORD is my strength and my shield, in Him hath my heart trusted, and I am helped; therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth, and with my song will I praise Him.
verses.kjv: The LORD [is] my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.
verses.web: Yahweh is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.

verses.he: יְהוָ֥ה עֹֽז־לָ֑מֹו וּמָ֘עֹ֤וז יְשׁוּעֹ֖ות מְשִׁיחֹ֣ו הֽוּא׃
verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ عِزٌّ لَهُمْ، وَحِصْنُ خَلَاصِ مَسِيحِهِ هُوَ.
verses.en: The LORD is a strength unto them; and He is a stronghold of salvation to His anointed.
verses.kjv: The LORD [is] their strength, and he [is] the saving strength of his anointed.
verses.web: Yahweh is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.

verses.he: הֹושִׁ֤יעָה ׀ אֶת־עַמֶּ֗ךָ וּבָרֵ֥ךְ אֶת־נַחֲלָתֶ֑ךָ וּֽרְעֵ֥ם וְ֝נַשְּׂאֵ֗ם עַד־הָעֹולָֽם׃
verses.ar: خَلِّصْ شَعْبَكَ، وَبَارِكْ مِيرَاثَكَ، وَٱرْعَهُمْ وَٱحْمِلْهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ.
verses.en: Save Thy people, and bless Thine inheritance; and tend them, and carry them for ever.
verses.kjv: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.
verses.web: Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever.
